title: a TLS read interrupted by a timeout or a cancelled task does not lose the data that arrives later
purpose: Exercise a protocol boundary against a suite-owned loopback fixture.

provenance.expected_basis: The fixture stays silent until the client's byte, which the client sends after a read bounded to 0.1 s has timed out and a read in a cancelled task has ended Cancelled; the next read receives the 5 bytes `late!`: interrupted reads leave nothing pending that could take the record (#312).
